card.text: The coldest companion imaged before JWST, circling a Sun-like star 18 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baburaj et al. 2026
sources.quote: As the coldest imaged PMC of the pre-JWST era

introduction.text: GJ 504 b glows at about 560 K. JWST's spectrum points to about 25 Jupiter masses and an age of billions of years, which would make it a brown dwarf.
